* feat(auth): harden App access management

- preserve legacy authorization rows during migration while enforcing new input formats\n- make App access management foundational and versioned\n- add consistent effective-access evaluation and backend pagination\n- protect tenant profile data with explicit permissions and optimistic concurrency

Keep unchanged legacy fields grandfathered during status updates.\nLimit effective-access role loading to the bound transitive closure.

* fix(auth): bound role graph traversal

Deduplicate recursive role closure by role ID and validate cycles and\ndepth with a memoized graph walk. This prevents dense inheritance DAGs\nfrom expanding exponentially during policy updates and access checks.
